faqItems.q: Can hospice care be provided at home in Woodland Hills?
faqItems.a: Yes. Home is the most common care setting. Our nurses, aides, social workers and chaplains visit the patient at their residence. Medical equipment and medications related to the hospice diagnosis are coordinated and delivered as needed.

faqItems.q: How quickly can hospice services begin in Woodland Hills?
faqItems.a: Same-day evaluation may be available when clinically appropriate and operationally available. After a referral or intake call, a nurse will schedule an in-person visit to complete the clinical assessment and enrollment paperwork.

faqItems.q: Who qualifies for hospice care in Woodland Hills?
faqItems.a: Hospice is appropriate when a physician certifies that a patient has a terminal illness with a prognosis of six months or less if the illness follows its natural course, and the patient and family choose comfort-focused care over curative treatment.

faqItems.q: Does Eternal Life Hospice serve patients near West Hills Hospital or Kaiser Permanente in Woodland Hills?
faqItems.a: Yes. Our team coordinates with hospital social workers and discharge planners at local hospitals to facilitate smooth transitions to home-based hospice care. We work with the patient's existing medical team to maintain continuity of care.
